scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving weather & daily plans
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Weather and Daily Plans
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: weather & daily plans — a misunderstanding or problem involving weather & daily plans
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving weather & daily plans; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan tells Mr Thomas it is very hot and she has no water.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nói với anh Thomas trời rất nóng mà không mang nước.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Thomas, it is very hot and I have no water.
turns.vietnamese: Thomas này, trời nóng quá mà tôi không mang nước.

turns.speaker: Mr Thomas
turns.vietnamese: Đây, chị uống một ít nước của tôi này.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: That is very kind of you.
